title: Titanium Immersion Heater Sheath
function: Electric immersion heater protective sheath tube
alloyReason: Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is selected for this tank hardware application prioritizing formability and corrosion resistance over strength. With 40% elongation and excellent weldability, its natural TiO2 passivation provides immunity to pitting in chlorides up to 260C. This rationale is driven by electric immersion heater protective sheath tube and fat life requirements.
process: CNC machining CP Ti for tank hardware geometry
TIG welding Ti filler with SPC sampling
Pickling and passivation with SPC sampling
Continuity test <1 mOhm with SPC sampling
surfaceTreatment: Platinum cladding 2.5um minimum via electrodeposition for stable catalytic surface in electrochemical cells — tailored for electric immersion heater application
inspection: Adhesion tape ASTM D3359 (electric immersion verified)
commonFailures: Precious metal drag-out >15% on complex racks - minimized by robotic extract 0.5m/min + air knife — critical for electric immersion heater performance

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Immersion Heater Sheath suitable for Electric immersion heater protective sheath tube?
faq.a: Titanium Immersion Heater Sheath uses Grade 2 CP-Ti because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address tank hardware operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Immersion Heater Sheath?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Immersion Heater Sheath is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for electric immersion heater requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Immersion Heater Sheath require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. electric immersion heater components require Platinum cladding 2.5um minimum via electrodeposition for stable catalytic surface in electrochemical cells — tailored for electric immersion heater application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Immersion Heater Sheath shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment of Titanium Immersion Heater Sheath includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance confirming all processes meet electric immersion heater specifications; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements on critical features; (4) Surface roughness certification per applicable standards. FAIR available on request.

faq.q: What is the MOQ and typical lead time for Heater sheath / Immersion heater tank hardware components?
faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
